Hi Sara —

Thanks for agreeing to kick off the vendor setup with us. To get the buyer intake and PO pipeline set up, can you please provide the following items so Finance and Procurement can complete the vendor record? We aim to have this done before we issue the first PO (target: next week).

Required items (please attach PDFs where possible):
- Legal entity name and DBA (as it should appear on the PO)
- Legal mailing address and remit-to address (if different)
- Federal Tax ID (EIN) or foreign tax identifier; indicate whether you are US or non-US entity
- Completed W-9 (US) or W-8BEN-E (non-US) as applicable
- Bank details for ACH (bank name, routing, account number, account name) — if you prefer wires, indicate bank wiring details and SWIFT/BIC
- Bank letter or voided check to verify account ownership (PDF)
- Preferred invoice email and contact for remit questions
- Any special contractual invoicing terms (PO number required on invoice, invoice-to address, tax-exempt certificates if applicable)

Optional but helpful:
- Supplier contact for order/PO acknowledgement
- A point of contact for billing disputes and payment exceptions

For POs: our standard is Net 30 unless otherwise negotiated. If you require a different payment term or need a purchase order template adjusted, flag that now so Legal/Finance can review.

I've attached our short vendor onboarding form to speed this up — feel free to fill and return, or send the separate docs above.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
